description: Import a local file into the vault and optionally insert a relative Obsidian embed into a note. The imported file is retained if the note insertion fails, with its recovery path in the error.

contextAfter.description: Optional exact text immediately after the insertion cursor.

contextBefore.description: Optional exact text immediately before the insertion cursor.

dryRun.description: Preview the change without applying it: returns the planned action and the exact CLI command.

embed.description: Insert an Obsidian embed after importing the file.

folder.description: Optional vault-relative destination folder for the imported file.

note.description: Vault-relative Markdown note to receive the embed.

position.description: Optional zero-based cursor for the embed insertion.

ch.description: Zero-based UTF-16 column within the line.

sourcePath.description: Absolute local path to the file being imported.

name: note_attach
title: Import and attach file to note
